displayName: ChAI Agent Registry and Task Escrow (Sol.College demonstration)
description: AI agent labour market on devnet with two Anchor programs: a registry where an admin oracle verifies agents with a reputation score, and a SOL task escrow where an oracle approves or rejects submitted results. All instructions except a 48 h timeout reclaim verified with real transactions.
demonstrationNotice: Sol.College-owned demonstration of ladymillard/chai-sol. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/chai-sol. The lab only changed declare_id to a unique Sol.College devnet program. The upstream author has not joined Sol.College; acceptance here is by Sol.College, not by the upstream project.

scope: Anchor program correctness (registry verification, task escrow, oracle settlement)
Frontend reliability of the hosted devnet console at sol.college/dapps/chai-sol/
QA: devnet proof of oracle-settled agent tasks
exclusions: Changes to the upstream repository other than ordinary pull requests
Security disclosure in public (security findings go to private channels)

assignments.title: Let reopened tasks accept a new result
